title_hook: Nobody sees the stone grow. Keep dripping.
concept: The stalactite - pillars built one drop at a time in the dark
quote: The pillar is not built on the day it is finished.
core_metaphor: Cave water building stone columns: unmeasurable increments, inevitable structure.
primary_prompt: 9:16 vertical cinematic sequence: a single droplet falling in a dark limestone cavern, thousands of drops stacking mineral in the same spot, stalactite and stalagmite fusing into one column, ending in a cathedral of finished pillars in gold light.

hook.text: Nobody sees the stone grow. That is why most people quit.
hook.visual: 9:16 vertical, deep limestone cavern in near darkness (#14110F). A single droplet forms at the tip of a long stalactite, lit by one thin shaft of bone-white (#F5F2EB) light from above. Extreme slow motion as it falls. Camera static, low angle.

build.text: A cave builds its pillars one drop at a time. One drop does nothing you can measure. Ten thousand drops do nothing you can see.
build.visual: Macro: the droplet strikes a stalagmite tip and bursts into a crown of water, leaving a microscopic ring of gold (#C6A94F) mineral. Time-lapse of thousands of drops landing in the exact same spot, mineral layers stacking. Rhythmic, patient.

pivot.text: Then one day the column touches the floor, and the cave has a spine it did not have before.
pivot.visual: Slow upward tilt: stalactite and stalagmite meeting and fusing into a single continuous column, the joint glowing faint crimson (#DC143C) at the moment of contact. Monumental scale, wet stone texture, dust in the light shaft.

resolution.text: Your reps are drops. Your pages are drops. Your quiet mornings are drops. Keep falling in the same place.
resolution.visual: Wide shot: a cathedral-like cavern filled with finished stone columns, each catching gold (#C6A94F) light. Camera glides slowly between them. Silent, ancient, inevitable.

mobius_close.text: Because the pillar is not built on the day it is finished. It is built every day you...
mobius_close.visual: Camera rises back up to a single new droplet forming at the tip of a young stalactite in darkness, the bone-white (#F5F2EB) light shaft returning. Matches the opening frame.

caption: One drop does nothing you can measure. Ten thousand do nothing you can see. Then the column touches the floor.
